description: Defines the ue_fallback_scheduler class responsible for scheduling fallback UE grants in a 5G NR scheduler, including handling buffer indications, contention resolution, and retransmissions.

classes.name: ue_fallback_scheduler
classes.description: Scheduler class for fallback state UE grant allocation, handling DL/UL grants, retransmissions, and buffer indications.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Handles DL buffer state reports for a UE.

methods.name: handle_conres_indication
methods.description: Handles contention resolution indications.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Handles UL buffer status report indications.

methods.name: handle_sr_indication
methods.description: Handles scheduling request indications.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules UE's SRB0 DL grants for a slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler when cell is deactivated.

methods.name: schedule_dl_retx
methods.description: Schedules DL retransmissions; returns false to stop scheduling.

methods.name: schedule_ul_new_tx_and_retx
methods.description: Schedules UL SRB1 new transmissions and retransmissions.

methods.name: get_dl_new_tx_alloc_type
methods.description: Determines the type of DL new transmission needed for a UE.

methods.name: schedule_dl_new_tx
methods.description: Schedules pending DL new transmissions for specific UE types.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Removes acknowledged HARQ processes from cache.

methods.name: schedule_dl_srb
methods.description: Schedules DL SRB0/SRB1 and/or contention resolution for a UE.

methods.name: schedule_ul_ue
methods.description: Schedules UL SRB1 message for a UE.

methods.name: select_tbs
methods.description: Selects appropriate MCS and TBS for pending bytes.

methods.name: alloc_grant
methods.description: Allocates DL grant for a UE and PDSCH slot.

methods.name: schedule_ul_srb
methods.description: Schedules UL SRB1 message for a UE on a specific PUSCH resource.

methods.name: fill_dl_srb_grant
methods.description: Fills DL grant details for an SRB message.

methods.name: fill_ul_srb_grant
methods.description: Fills UL grant details for an SRB message.

methods.name: get_pdsch_td_cfg
methods.description: Returns PDSCH time domain resource configuration.

methods.name: get_pdsch_time_res_idx
methods.description: Determines suitable PDSCH time resource index based on configuration.
